description: We are a team in the making looking to discover what hackatons are all about !
summary: We attempted to make a software that would be able, from a single tif file from the area studied, to use multiple filters in order to prepare for a maximum a possible scenarios both from earth and while on the martian surface. You would also be able to place points on the map through the user interface.
details:
Unfortunately, we were unable to complete the project. We took a lot of time figuring how the libraries we were going to use work and how to use them due to the team's desire to avoid using generative AI in order to truly test our capacities.

The project is composed of two main files :

- The mars_map.ipynb who's in chareg of putting the filters on the base map and being able to change between them and modify the opacity of said filters. The map tiles were imported from a local server, but due to a lack of knowledge on that field, the program only boot up an interractive map half of the time. The other half it just returns an error.

- The UI_v0.1.py file with generates the graphic user interface. It works well, the only problem is that once again, due to difficulties with local servers, the program does not load the martian map. Instead, in order to demonstrate its functionalities, it displays a map of New-York easily fetchable by the python librairy from an online database.

The vast majority of the project was made using python.
